Mahtari Vandana Yojana Registrations Delayed, Affecting Over 10 Lakh Women

New registrations for the Mahtari Vandana Yojana have been stalled at the finance department, despite the Chief Minister's approval. This delay is impacting over 10 lakh women who are awaiting their benefits. In one district, over 3,000 women's 'vandan' amounts are reportedly at risk.
